verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a full agent-checkout stack: ACP/UCP checkout-session flows with delegated single-use Braintree/Google Pay tokens, a merchant-hosted cart API (createcart/getcart) that PayPal's Shopping Cart service calls to create and confirm orders, and agent-toolkit order/refund/dispute tools plus webhooks for confirmation events. However, eligibility is heavily gated (Braintree-only for Agent Ready, form-gated approval for agentic commerce services, Google-gated UCP enablement) and Store Sync is explicitly limited to US physical goods in USD, with no independent/hands-on evidence of a real end-to-end agent purchase succeeding in production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a completed live purchase, broader (non-US/digital-goods) coverage, and evidence of self-serve access without gating.
